description: Single source of truth for the Kerri scheduled-routine fleet. Every cron + event-triggered routine appears here exactly once. routine-liveness-check.mjs drives its registry from this file (the dark-detection logic stays in named evaluator functions in the script, mapped to entries by `evaluator`), and a completeness test asserts that every live scheduled-task and every CLAUDE-ROUTINES.md cron routine has an entry here. Add a routine? Add it here too, or the test goes red. Scope: KMG routines only (`kerri-*` / `standard-works-*` namespaces). `brian-*` scheduled tasks are Brian's personal tasks and are deliberately excluded from this manifest and its completeness test — personal data never enters the KMG brain. All times are ET (America/New_York). cron strings mirror agent-prompts/CLAUDE-ROUTINES.md.

routines.name: kerri-inbox-sweep
routines.cadenceDescription: weekdays every 15 min, 06:00-22:45 ET; weekends 10:00 and 16:00 ET

routines.name: kerri-morning-brief-retry
routines.cadenceDescription: weekdays ~07:18 ET; guarded retry, silent no-op when the brief already delivered

routines.name: kerri-cold-outreach
routines.cadenceDescription: weekdays ~09:07 ET; targets 10 approval-ready drafts, never auto-sends

routines.name: kerri-pipeline-followup
routines.cadenceDescription: Tue + Thu ~08:33 ET; approval-gated, never sends

routines.name: kerri-revenue-standup
routines.cadenceDescription: Friday ~16:00 ET; read-only scoreboard vs $1M (schedule activation pending Brian confirmation)

routines.name: kerri-renewal-watchdog
routines.cadenceDescription: Wednesday ~10:00 ET; scans CRM for expiring contracts (schedule activation pending Brian confirmation)

routines.name: kerri-self-improve
routines.cadenceDescription: Sundays ~17:00 ET; weekly self-improvement (scorecard + edit-pattern analysis)

routines.name: standard-works-issue-writer
routines.cadenceDescription: event-triggered (S/W newsletter issue cadence), not cron; never auto-posts
